labels.new_exact_curve: unverified globally; exact equation not found in checked sources
labels.new_eligible_family: unverified globally; earlier even-characteristic cubic classification likely contains this pole orbit
labels.new_attack_method: no; classical cover and traced correspondence

sources.title: Elliptic curves with weak coverings over cubic extensions of finite fields with even characteristic
sources.authors: Mahoro Shimura, Fumiyuki Momose, Jinhui Chao
sources.finding: Bibliographic record confirms a directly relevant prior cubic even-characteristic classification; full case table not retrieved, so this source prevents a family novelty claim.

sources.title: A classification of elliptic and hyperelliptic curves over finite fields of even characteristic subjected to the cover attack under the isogeny condition
sources.authors: Kousuke Murai, Mahoro Shimura, Tsutomu Iijima, Jinhui Chao
sources.finding: States a corrected classification under g(C)=d*g(C0); the present cubic elliptic to genus-three construction meets that condition. The one-page abstract does not identify its explicit row.

sources.title: A classification of elliptic curves with respect to the GHS attack in odd characteristic
sources.authors: Tsutomu Iijima, Fumiyuki Momose, Jinhui Chao
sources.finding: Its introduction explicitly reports a three-quarters density in the earlier even-characteristic work. The present three-screen union also tends to three quarters, so its asymptotic density cannot be advertised as novel.

sources.title: Genus 3 curves with many involutions and application to maximal curves in characteristic 2
sources.finding: Classifies genus-three covers with a k-rational V4 action. The present V4 is cycled by k-Frobenius, so direct identity of cases has not been established.

sources.title: Cover attacks for elliptic curves with prime order
sources.finding: A distinct cubic-extension transfer by a (l,l,l)-isogeny to a genus-three Jacobian; it cautions against calling any cubic genus-three route a new attack method.

sources.title: On the discrete logarithm problem for plane curves
sources.finding: Proves expected soft-O(q) DLP cost for nonhyperelliptic genus-three plane quartics over F_q; this is an asymptotic target-side bound, not a measured cost for the q16 source or for every cover in this family.

repository_prior.finding: Rational-pole Hess product gate and exact product count, distinct from this nonsplit pole screen.
Triangle screen. Companion PR #2737 adds the rational-pole Hess overlap; this report reproves that overlap before adding the nonsplit screen.
An earlier smooth quartic in the same q16 isogeny class 3.16.a_a_abr was found; its source map had not been evaluated. This candidate is a class rediscovery even if its exact equation differs.
